title: ASUS Vivobook Go 15 OLED (E1504F)
shortDescription: Budget 15.6-inch OLED laptop with AMD Ryzen processors and a 180-degree hinge.
description:
Vivobook Go 15 OLED brings an OLED display to a budget laptop, with AMD Ryzen and Athlon processor options.

It has a lay-flat 180-degree hinge, a webcam shield and comes in three colours.
highlights: Cool Silver, Mixed Black or Grey Green
